company.name: Harrow & Pike Solicitors LLP
company.description: A 25-person high-street law firm in Leeds handling residential conveyancing, wills and probate, family law and employment disputes. Clients email about progress on their matters, send documents, ask about fees and complain about delays. Conveyancing is very busy and the property search provider is running behind. The firm is regulated by the SRA and must handle client money and identity checks carefully.

injects.body: Demand to know why completion has not happened; removal van is booked for Friday and the seller's agent says the delay is on your side.

injects.title: Bank details change request
injects.body: Ask accounts to confirm the client account details for sending the deposit, because you have heard about email scams and want to be sure.
